audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME. Eleven fields on this matchup track an ability called 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no such ability. His E is Subject: Torment, and its three casts are Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. The packet's suspectNames array is empty, so nothing flagged this — it is invented whole rather than misspelt.
audit.why: This is the single worst defect in the matchup: a paying reader is told to track a button that does not exist, and the name is in the loading screen, the focus tracker, the win condition, the cooldowns field and four report entries. The real E is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, which is also the only source of crowd control anywhere in his kit and therefore the only thing that can cancel Death Lotus.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Subject: Torment (E) and its real cast names in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d, report[3].t and report[5].t. Two instances remain — see notes.
sources: enemyKit Hwei E name and text

audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits 54.94% over 3351 games. Hwei has no dash, no blink and no untargetability anywhere in his kit; his only answer to a Shunpo is one Subject: Torment cast on a 12s cooldown at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Label unchanged; the difficulty is now explained by the no-mobility fact rather than by a made-up ability.

audit.why: All seven rows read Katarina in the full layer, the content layer and the packet, and the kit supports it end to end: Level 3 Shunpo punishes every subject spell spent on the wave, Level 6 Death Lotus beats a stationary caster, and 2+ item teamfights reward reaching him rather than out-ranging him.
audit.corrected: No chart change, so no paired win[N] edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and the content 'late' field claimed his interrupt is 'on a 14-second-plus cooldown'.
audit.why: Subject: Torment is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 — never 14 or more. A reader who counts 14 seconds and steps up on the 13th walks into the one spell that cancels their ultimate.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with E 12s->10s, Q 10s->6s at 80-120 mana and R 120/100/80 at 1300 range; 'a 14-second-plus cooldown' -> 'a 10-to-12-second cooldown'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two more mechanical errors in the content layer. spikes[0].text called Signature of the Visionary 'his escape ... a slow channel with a long windup' — it is his PASSIVE, a damage detonation, not an escape and not a channel. spikes[1].text said he 'channels his own R Spiraling Despair' — the R is a cast that expands and then explodes, not a channel.
audit.why: Both would teach a reader to wait for a cast that never happens. The truthful and more useful version is that Hwei has no mobility at all, which is exactly why this lane is favoured.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now says he has no dash and no blink anywhere in his kit; spikes[1].text says 'answers with' rather than 'channels'. Also added the genuinely missing passive interaction to dosFull[0].d: Signature of the Visionary needs a SECOND damaging spell to complete, so leaving after the first one breaks the chain.
sources: enemyKit Hwei full kit — no dash flag anywhere

notes: READ THIS ONE. Eleven fields on this matchup tracked a fabricated ability called 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no such spell — his E is Subject: Torment (Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw). The packet's suspectNames was EMPTY, so the near-miss detector never saw it; it is invented rather than misspelt, which is a gap in that check worth looking at across other Hwei matchups. I replaced it in nine fields. TWO INSTANCES REMAIN that I could not fix without breaking the two-report-entries-per-matchup rule: report[1].t and report[9].t both still say 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. They need a follow-up edit. Level chart already agreed across both layers and the packet, so no chart edits and no paired win[N] edits. Two further mechanical errors fixed in the content layer: Signature of the Visionary was described as his escape channel (it is his passive) and Spiraling Despair as a channel (it is not), and his interrupt cooldown was written as '14-second-plus' when Subject: Torment is 12s at rank 1.
